ex.en: I bought a few eggs and a little milk.
ex.zh: 我買了幾顆蛋和一點牛奶。

ex.en: An egg should cook for at least 5 minutes.
ex.zh: 蛋至少要煮五分鐘。

ex.en: I can't eat raw eggs; they must be cooked.
ex.zh: 我不能吃生蛋，一定要煮熟。

egg.en: an oval object laid by a hen or other bird, often eaten as food

ex.en: Losing the game in front of his friends really hurt his ego.
ex.zh: 在朋友面前輸了比賽，讓他的自尊心很受傷。

ex.en: His big ego makes it hard for him to admit mistakes.
ex.zh: 他太自負了，很難承認自己的錯誤。

ego.en: your feeling of how important or good you are

ex.en: Egypt is famous for its ancient pyramids.
ex.zh: 埃及以古老的金字塔聞名。

ex.en: The Nile River flows through Egypt.
ex.zh: 尼羅河流經埃及。

ex.en: We visited an Egyptian museum full of ancient treasures.
ex.zh: 我們參觀了一間收藏滿滿古代珍寶的埃及博物館。

ex.en: The Egyptian pyramids attract millions of tourists every year.
ex.zh: 埃及的金字塔每年吸引數百萬名遊客。

ex.en: My neighbor is an Egyptian who moved here ten years ago.
ex.zh: 我的鄰居是十年前搬來的埃及人。

ex.en: Many Egyptians live along the banks of the Nile River.
ex.zh: 許多埃及人住在尼羅河沿岸。

ex.en: I fried some eggplant with garlic for dinner.
ex.zh: 我晚餐用大蒜炒了一些茄子。

ex.en: This eggplant is soft and has a dark purple skin.
ex.zh: 這條茄子很軟，外皮是深紫色。

ex.en: They want to build a more egalitarian society.
ex.zh: 他們想建立一個更平等的社會。

ex.en: The company has an egalitarian culture where everyone's ideas count.
ex.zh: 這間公司有著人人平等的文化，每個人的想法都受到重視。

ex.en: As an egalitarian, she believes everyone deserves equal chances.
ex.zh: 身為平等主義者，她認為每個人都應該有平等的機會。

ex.en: The group was founded by egalitarians who wanted fair pay for all.
ex.zh: 這個團體是由希望人人獲得公平薪資的平等主義者所創立的。

ex.en: The newspaper made an egregious error in the headline.
ex.zh: 報紙在標題上犯了一個極其嚴重的錯誤。

ex.en: That was an egregious waste of public money.
ex.zh: 那是對公款極其惡劣的浪費。

ex.en: A white egret stood still in the shallow water.
ex.zh: 一隻白鷺靜靜站在淺水裡。

ex.en: We saw several egrets resting in the rice fields.
ex.zh: 我們看到幾隻白鷺在稻田裡休息。

ex.en: Be careful not to drop any eggshell into the batter.
ex.zh: 小心別讓蛋殼掉進麵糊裡。

ex.en: The baby bird broke out of its eggshell this morning.
ex.zh: 小鳥今天早上破殼而出。

ex.en: Egalitarianism is the belief that all people deserve equal rights.
ex.zh: 平等主義認為所有人都應享有平等的權利。

ex.en: The school's egalitarianism means every student gets the same chances.
ex.zh: 這所學校奉行平等主義，每個學生都有相同的機會。

ex.en: Many people admire the egalitarianism of the Nordic countries.
ex.zh: 許多人欣賞北歐國家的平等主義精神。
